Solution: -21.75 - (-4.5) = -21.75 + 4.5 = -17.25, so the diver descended 17.25 meters. Check: initial value + signed change = final value. A negative change means a decrease. Exact check: -4.5 = -4.5; -21.75-(-4.5) = -17.25.
